pages.text: Meteor gear is too big for a normal crafting table. The Shellrock Crafting Table has a $(thing)5x5$() grid for armour, legendary weapons and baubles, and it still crafts everything a normal table does.$(br2)With JEI installed, its recipes show up there too, with a button that fills the grid for you.
